original_document.title: WE Business Value Plans | Corporate Mobile Packages in Egypt - TE Business - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: WE Business Value bundles: - WE Business Value 58: Units 1250, Mobile Internet 1500 MB, Intra-Company Minutes 1000. - WE Business Value 80: Units 2000, Mobile Internet 2500 MB, Intra-Company Minutes 1500. - WE Business Value 175: Units 4000, Mobile Internet 6000 MB, Intra-Company Minutes 1500. - WE Business Value 345: Units 8000, Mobile Internet 13000 MB, Intra-Company Minutes 2000. - WE Business Value 520: Units 13000, Mobile Internet 20000 MB. - WE Business Value 780: Units 18000, Mobile Internet 32000 MB.

Terms & Conditions: - 1 minute or SMS to WE = 1 unit. - 1 minute to landline = 1 unit. - 1 minute or SMS to any other network = 5 units. - 1 MB = 1 unit. - Follow up rates for minutes and SMSs out of the bundle is 14 pt. - The roaming receiving minute rate only applies in certain countries, for more details call 522. - All prices are tax exclusive.
